channel.title: publish-plugin-charty
channel.description: Add some charts to your life

item.title: Custom colours
item.content:encoded:
Any series can override the generated palette with colour (or color). Anything CSS understands works, and the rest of the chart carries on using the theme.

Definition

{
  "title": "Platform colours",
  "caption": "Each series pinned to its own colour",
  "type": "bar",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Swift",
      "value": 48210,
      "colour": "#F05138"
    },
    {
      "label": "Objective-C",
      "value": 12640,
      "colour": "#438EFF"
    },
    {
      "label": "C",
      "value": 4380,
      "colour": "#A8B9CC"
    },
    {
      "label": "Metal",
      "value": 1120,
      "colour": "#8E44AD"
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Rating
item.content:encoded:
Laid out with HTML rather than SVG, and measured against the highest value in the set. Use rating or review.

Definition

{
  "title": "Package health",
  "caption": "Scored out of ten",
  "type": "review",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Documentation",
      "value": 9
    },
    {
      "label": "Test coverage",
      "value": 8
    },
    {
      "label": "API stability",
      "value": 7
    },
    {
      "label": "Release cadence",
      "value": 5
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Radar
item.content:encoded:
Values are percentages plotted around a set of named axes. Give the axis names in points at the top level of the chart.

Definition

{
  "title": "SwiftUI against UIKit",
  "caption": "Team survey, percentage satisfied",
  "type": "radar",
  "points": ["Layout", "Animation", "Testing", "Tooling", "Docs", "Accessibility", "Performance", "Adoption"],
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "SwiftUI",
      "value": [88, 92, 61, 74, 70, 82, 66, 90]
    },
    {
      "label": "UIKit",
      "value": [64, 58, 79, 85, 88, 76, 91, 55]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Area (layered)
item.content:encoded:
Series are layered rather than stacked, each drawn partly transparent so the ones behind stay visible.

Definition

{
  "title": "Downloads by platform",
  "caption": "Layered, not summed",
  "type": "area",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "iOS",
      "value": [5200, 6300, 8500, 7400, 9200, 8300, 9900, 11400]
    },
    {
      "label": "macOS",
      "value": [1200, 2300, 4500, 3400, 5200, 4300, 5900, 7400]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Area
item.content:encoded:
A filled line chart, closed along the baseline.

Definition

{
  "title": "Monthly downloads",
  "caption": "Swift Package Index resolutions",
  "type": "area",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "2026",
      "value": [1200, 2300, 4500, 3400, 5200, 4300, 5900, 7400]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Bubble
item.content:encoded:
A scatter chart where the point size scales with the value, so magnitude reads without needing the axis.

Definition

{
  "title": "Package downloads",
  "caption": "By release, weighted by size",
  "type": "bubble",
  "options": {
    "numbers": false
  },
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Charty",
      "value": [2455, 7665, 4700, 7000, 4430, 8142]
    },
    {
      "label": "Publish",
      "value": [6321, 8765, 2230, 8730, 14430, 9142]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Scatter
item.content:encoded:
Points with no line between them. Set numbers to false where the shape of the data matters more than the readings.

Definition

{
  "title": "Incremental build times",
  "caption": "Seconds per commit, sampled",
  "type": "scatter",
  "options": {
    "numbers": false
  },
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Debug",
      "value": [12, 9, 14, 8, 21, 11, 7, 16, 10, 13]
    },
    {
      "label": "Release",
      "value": [38, 44, 31, 52, 29, 47, 35, 41, 58, 33]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Line (multiple)
item.content:encoded:
Several series share one axis. Hovering the legend fades the others so a single line can be followed across the chart.

Definition

{
  "title": "Tests over time",
  "caption": "Count per release",
  "type": "line",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Unit",
      "value": [312, 388, 441, 507, 596, 664, 712, 803]
    },
    {
      "label": "Integration",
      "value": [48, 62, 71, 90, 104, 118, 131, 149]
    },
    {
      "label": "UI",
      "value": [22, 24, 31, 36, 41, 44, 52, 58]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Line
item.content:encoded:
Points joined in order. Hover a series to read its values.

Definition

{
  "title": "CI build duration",
  "caption": "Minutes per release, main branch",
  "type": "line",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "main",
      "value": [24, 26, 22, 19, 17, 18, 14, 12]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Stacked column
item.content:encoded:
The stacked chart running horizontally.

Definition

{
  "title": "Source lines by release",
  "caption": "The same data, running horizontally",
  "type": "column-stacked",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Swift",
      "value": [21400, 33800, 48210]
    },
    {
      "label": "Objective-C",
      "value": [28600, 19200, 12640]
    },
    {
      "label": "C",
      "value": [5200, 4900, 4380]
    },
    {
      "label": "Metal",
      "value": [420, 780, 1120]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Stacked bar
item.content:encoded:
Each column is shown as a share of its own total, so the axis reads in percentages no matter how large the underlying numbers are.

Definition

{
  "title": "Source lines by release",
  "caption": "Share of the codebase per language",
  "type": "bar-stacked",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Swift",
      "value": [21400, 33800, 48210]
    },
    {
      "label": "Objective-C",
      "value": [28600, 19200, 12640]
    },
    {
      "label": "C",
      "value": [5200, 4900, 4380]
    },
    {
      "label": "Metal",
      "value": [420, 780, 1120]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Grouped bar
item.content:encoded:
Several values per series groups them along the axis. Bars within a group sit close together, groups sit apart, and the legend names the series.

Definition

{
  "title": "Build time by configuration",
  "caption": "Seconds, clean build, across three releases",
  "type": "bar",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Debug",
      "value": [142, 128, 96]
    },
    {
      "label": "Release",
      "value": [318, 296, 241]
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Column
item.content:encoded:
The same chart running horizontally. Long category names have room to breathe, and the text stays upright.

Definition

{
  "title": "Downloads by platform",
  "caption": "The same data, running horizontally",
  "type": "column",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "iOS",
      "value": 18420
    },
    {
      "label": "macOS",
      "value": 9310
    },
    {
      "label": "watchOS",
      "value": 2140
    },
    {
      "label": "tvOS",
      "value": 1180
    },
    {
      "label": "visionOS",
      "value": 860
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Bar
item.content:encoded:
One value per series gives each series its own slot along the axis. The value axis rounds up to a readable ceiling and steps in even intervals.

Definition

{
  "title": "Downloads by platform",
  "caption": "Swift Package Index, last 30 days",
  "type": "bar",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "iOS",
      "value": 18420
    },
    {
      "label": "macOS",
      "value": 9310
    },
    {
      "label": "watchOS",
      "value": 2140
    },
    {
      "label": "tvOS",
      "value": 1180
    },
    {
      "label": "visionOS",
      "value": 860
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Rings
item.content:encoded:
One concentric ring per series. Values may be fractions between 0 and 1, or percentages between 0 and 100.

Definition

{
  "title": "Test coverage by target",
  "caption": "Line coverage from the last CI run",
  "type": "rings",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Core",
      "value": 0.92
    },
    {
      "label": "Networking",
      "value": 0.78
    },
    {
      "label": "UI",
      "value": 0.54
    },
    {
      "label": "Analytics",
      "value": 0.31
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Section
item.content:encoded:
Values are fractions between 0 and 1, taken at face value. They need not add up to a whole circle, which makes this useful for showing progress.

Definition

{
  "title": "Swift 6 migration",
  "caption": "Targets moved to strict concurrency",
  "type": "sectional",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Complete",
      "value": 0.55
    },
    {
      "label": "In review",
      "value": 0.18
    },
    {
      "label": "Blocked",
      "value": 0.07
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Donut
item.content:encoded:
A pie chart with the middle cut out. Use donut or doughnut — both resolve to the same chart.

Definition

{
  "title": "App bundle size",
  "caption": "Where the megabytes go",
  "type": "doughnut",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Executable",
      "value": 34.2
    },
    {
      "label": "Asset catalog",
      "value": 21.8
    },
    {
      "label": "Frameworks",
      "value": 15.4
    },
    {
      "label": "Localisations",
      "value": 6.1
    },
    {
      "label": "Other",
      "value": 2.5
    }
  ]
}

item.title: Pie
item.content:encoded:
Each slice is its share of the total. Values can be any scale — Charty works out the percentages.

Definition

{
  "title": "Source lines by language",
  "caption": "A typical mixed Apple-platform codebase",
  "type": "pie",
  "data": [
    {
      "label": "Swift",
      "value": 48210
    },
    {
      "label": "Objective-C",
      "value": 12640
    },
    {
      "label": "C",
      "value": 4380
    },
    {
      "label": "Metal",
      "value": 1120
    }
  ]
}
